# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues.

Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/lscythe/kemana-proxy/security/advisories/new) for this repository. Include:

- A description of the vulnerability
- The affected version or commit
- Steps to reproduce or a proof of concept
- The potential impact
- Any suggested mitigation

Remove credentials and personal data from reports.

## Response process

The maintainer acknowledges valid reports, investigates them privately, and coordinates the fix and disclosure timing with the reporter. Allow reasonable time for a fix before public disclosure.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release and the `develop` branch receive security fixes.
